A known allergy: a patch test before the day, or that product is left out
Someone added late: only if an artist is free before the ready-by time, with the owner's OK
Someone under 18 in the party: a parent's yes, and the parent stays
The lead artist can't come: a trusted stand-in the contract names, or a full refund
The customer moves the date: one free move, if the artists are free that day
The customer cancels: only what the contract says is kept, with the owner's OK
The party moves to another place on the day: the travel fee is checked again before anyone agrees
Storms on the wedding morning: the artists leave early at no charge
